milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate to the stone brick workshop and visually locate the grindstone at spawn-relative (7, 0, 8). max_distance=5 ensures the player has actually walked toward the workshop (grindstone is ~10 blocks from spawn), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is oriented toward the grindstone, confirming visual observation.

Uses inventory_has because mining polished diorite stairs with a pickaxe causes the block to drop as an item into the player's inventory. The scene has 4 polished diorite stairs blocks and the player is given an iron pickaxe, so mining at least 1 is sufficient to complete the task.
